## 2618 MERGED -- main's macOS fix is in; verifying rather than declaring

Ten changes merged tonight: 2593, 2596, 2600, 2614, 2594, 2607, 2601, 2609, 2613, 2618. 860b's close
gate is running.

2618 needed THREE patchsets. Patchset 2 failed pytest ubuntu py3.12, which is worth remembering: its
fix is in tests/_isolation.py, the git probe the autouse _no_repo_commits guard calls on EVERY test on
EVERY platform. A retry loop there is not a macOS-local change. I framed it to the agent as 'my change
caused this is the leading hypothesis, disprove it' rather than the reverse, which is the right prior
for a change that touches a universal helper.

DID NOT DECLARE MAIN GREEN. Dispatched branch-head run 33875177644 against main to verify the actual
sweep (macos, full suite) job, because earlier tonight I called main healthy off the four pytest cells
and missed a regression in the sweep tier -- which was, ironically, this very bug. Checking the cells
a change could REACH rather than the ones it was ABOUT is the lesson, and it costs one dispatch.

The AC2 evidence already looked good -- workflow_dispatch run 33855430270 showed sweep (macos, full
suite) = SUCCESS, 19243 passed + 1 ERROR before, 19244 passed with 0 errors after -- but that was
against the FIX BRANCH. This dispatch is against MAIN with the fix merged, which is the claim actually
being made.

Also recorded on the ticket: my premise in it was wrong. I asserted the blamed test 'provisions a real
Node toolchain and is the heaviest thing in the suite'; it drives a shell stub npm and is one of the
cheapest. Right conclusion, wrong mechanism, and the agent corrected it by checking rather than
inheriting. That is twice tonight an agent has corrected a hypothesis I handed it -- both times by
reading the tree instead of my summary. The instruction 'verify the specifics against the tree rather
than re-deriving' is doing real work in these briefs.

2619 is on patchset 3 after resolving its Makefile conflict, awaiting gates.
